data_fields.name: rng_state_words
data_fields.donor_constant: 4 numbers (c, s0, s1, s2) as plain data

data_fields.name: shuffle_draws_per_item
data_fields.donor_constant: one draw per remaining item (n items, n draws)

data_fields.name: default_seed_length
data_fields.donor_constant: last 10 characters of Date.now() in base 36 (time-based; not for Frankendom)

best_idea: Keep every random draw a pure function of stored state, store that state as four plain numbers in the fight state, and let the client discard any move that drew randomness until the server answers.
decision_why: Pure draws, plain-data state, player-view redaction and the client-discard rule fit server-verified kills; the time-based seed default and raw Number() exposure are donor defects to drop, and the single stream is split into named sub-streams.
acceptance: A server test replays one duel from (seed, move list) with identical rolls; the player view for each side has no rng key; a client test shows a roll-using action leaves displayed HP unchanged until the server answers.
